grid-paths.subject: A bronze lattice of square tiles with two glowing routes from one corner to the opposite corner, one amber and one cyan, crossing in the middle.

memo-ward.subject: A bronze shield with a small brass ledger book set into its centre and a cyan crystal bookmark sticking out of it.

lcs.subject: Two parallel bronze rails of crystals, the matching crystals in both rows joined by bright gold threads.

catalan.subject: A bronze bracket pair drawn as two curved metal arcs, nested twice, with a cyan crystal held at the centre.

table-ward.subject: A bronze tablet shield with a small grid of glowing cells, the last cell bright cyan.

rod-cutting.subject: A long amber crystal rod on a bronze workbench, cut by two thin gold lines into three segments of different lengths.

equal-partition.subject: A bronze balance scale perfectly level, each pan holding a different number of crystals.

unbounded-knapsack.subject: A bronze knapsack with an endless stream of identical cyan crystals pouring into it from a small brass tap.

edit-distance.subject: Two short bronze strips of crystals one above the other, small gold arrows linking each upper crystal to its partner below, one crystal struck through with a line.
